description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 11/2021 Excise Duty on Liquor
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new excise duty rates on various types of liquor through regulatory authority granted by the Excise Ordinance. It contains specific regulatory provisions, amends previous regulations, and exercises statutory powers under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
